title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: An agent makes 4 model calls to finish a request. The tool results are added to the history after each call. Which statement about the second call is true?

options.text: The model recalls call 1 without being sent it
The program sends the earlier history again, plus the new result
Only the newest tool result is sent to the model
The history is stored in the model's trained weights

items.stem: A loop has 3 calls. Call 1 sends 1,500 input tokens. The model replies with 100 tokens and a tool returns 400 tokens, so call 2 sends the call 1 input, that reply and that result. Call 2 then produces 100 tokens and a tool returns 300 tokens, which go into call 3 the same way. How many input tokens are sent across all 3 calls in total?

On Monday a student tells the assistant they prefer evening slots, and the assistant saves nothing. On Friday the student starts a new chat. Does the assistant know the preference, and why or why not?
The makerspace has a 60-page vinyl cutter manual. A student asks about blade depth for thick vinyl. What should go into the window for that question?

options.text: The few chunks that best match the question
The whole manual, so nothing is missed
Only the page numbers of the manual
Nothing, since the model already learned it

items.stem: Name one way that a saved note and a retrieved manual chunk are alike, and one way they differ.
